prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Atlanta to replace my air conditioner?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t truthfully name one single “best” company without knowing your neighborhood, budget and preferences, but I can help you find the right contractor and avoid problems. Quick plan:

1) If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and I’ll pull a short list of highly rated Atlanta HVAC companies near you.

2) What to look for when choosing a company
- Proper licensing and insurance (company and techs insured; ask to see proof).  
- NATE‑certified technicians (or equivalent).  
- Good local ratings and recent reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB).  
- Experience with full system replacements and local permitting.  
- Clear written estimate with equipment model, SEER rating, scope of work, labor warranty and parts warranty.  
- They perform a Manual J load calculation to size the system (not “rule of thumb” sizing).  
- Permits and proper disposal of old equipment included.  
- Fair, itemized bids and financing options if needed.

3) Questions to ask every contractor
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide proof?  
- Will you do a Manual J (load) and Manual D (duct) if needed?  
- Which brands/models do you recommend and why? What are total installed costs?  
- What are the parts and labor warranties? Are there extended warranties?  
- Who will perform the work (employees or subs)? Are techs NATE‑certified?  
- Will you obtain permits and handle inspections?  
- Can you provide local references from recent full replacements?

4) How to compare bids
- Don’t pick solely on lowest price. Compare system size (tons), SEER, coil/line‑set replacements, ductwork repairs, warranty lengths, and whether price includes permits and startup testing.  
- Ask for estimated annual energy cost for each option so you can compare efficiency vs cost.

5) Names to consider (examples to start your search)
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning  
- Coolray  
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin (local franchise variations)  
- ARS/Rescue Rooter / Rescue Rooter affiliates  
Note: those are regional/national names with Atlanta presence; many excellent local independent contractors also do great work. Check recent local reviews and the criteria above.

If you give me your ZIP code, the age/size of your home, and whether you prefer national chains or local companies, I’ll find 3–5 top-rated Atlanta HVAC contractors and summarize their strengths, recent ratings, and contact links.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
